name: Naghwa
source:
Early in the summer, the petals inside me fluttered. With precious memories with her...
The story that will make your heart beat.

[Translated from [url=https://m.onestore.co.kr/mobilepoc/apps/appsDetail.omp?prodId=0000723257]onestore[/url]]

初夏时，花瓣在我心中飘落。
和她一起度过的珍贵时光……
这是一段让你心跳加速的故事。
